high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals standing indoors in what appears to be a well-lit, modern building with a spacious, open floor plan. The setting includes large windows with glass panes and metal frames, allowing natural light to flood the area. The walls are painted white, and there is a polished, light-colored floor that reflects the light. The person on the left is wearing a traditional Indian saree. The saree is predominantly black with gold accents along the border and pallu (the draped part of the saree). The blouse is green with a golden border, complementing the saree.
